Interface RemoteController

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
GameController
public interface RemoteController extends Remote
The remote controller interface exposing the primary game action gateway over networks.

This interface defines the transactional contract for client-to-server communications during an active gameplay session. It acts as the distributed Controller within the MVC architecture, receiving raw interaction intents from remote clients and forwarding validated operations down to the domain model engine.

All methods declare throwing RemoteException to intercept and handle potential network layer disruptions or disconnection states during remote method invocations.

    • executeCardAction

      void executeCardAction(String prefix, int n) throws RemoteException
      Executes a generalized, dynamically parsed card action context using structured prefix tags and destination indices.

      This method serves as a polymorphic routing endpoint, mapping pre-processed alphanumeric commands forwarded by components like the NetworkManager into explicit game logic branches.

      Parameters:
      prefix - the isolated alphabetical section key identifying the target market or board zone
      n - the numerical index tracking the exact element selection within that zone
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if a network communication or transport routing failure occurs
